name: codex-kanban
description: A Codex-native task board. Four columns, approvals, blockers and durable repository-local state, driven by MCP tools and a kanban skill.

interface.shortDescription: A task board Codex can read and write
interface.longDescription: Codex Kanban gives Codex a task layer that outlives the conversation. Four columns, automatic Needs you, blockers, questions with options, approvals, comments and activity, stored in a repository-local .kanban/board.json and exposed through native MCP tools. A local web board is included for humans who prefer a browser.
defaultPrompt: Show me what needs my attention on the kanban board
Add a task for the login bug and put it in Backlog
